verifications.claim: The Texas House of Representatives is the lower chamber of the Texas Legislature.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'a bicameral body composed of a 31-member Senate and a 150-member House of Representatives.' R6: 'the lower house of the bicameral Texas Legislature.'
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated in multiple sources as the lower house.
